title: Embedded Analytics Row-Level Security Denials
dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash logs (`redash:app`), and embed client events (`bi:embed:client`).
app: Superset/Metabase/Redash application and Celery worker logs via Universal Forwarder; application REST APIs and embed-SDK client telemetry via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=bi:embed:client event="rls_denied" OR event="token_invalid" OR http_status=403
| stats count as denials, dc(tenant_id) as tenants by embed_dashboard, reason
| where denials>0
| sort - denials
description: Monitors embedded-analytics clients for row-level-security denials and invalid signed tokens, which indicate either a legitimate access boundary working or a misconfigured tenant filter blocking users.
value: In embedded multi-tenant BI, an RLS misconfiguration either leaks data or locks out a paying tenant; monitoring denials catches both failure modes.
implementation: Emit embed-SDK client telemetry to HEC with tenant context; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on denial spikes for a tenant.
visualization: Table of dashboard/reason by denials and tenant count.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the security checks in embedded dashboards so customers see only their own data and are not wrongly locked out.
